questions.prompt: What are we told about the pin the leaf stands on?

options.text: Nothing anchors it, so the leaf can settle and bed its heel firmly against the wall iron.
It is fixed hard into the stone below, so the heel cannot shift once the water rises.
It carries the leaf's weight, which is usually why the collar above it has to be shimmed.
It takes the whole of the water's push, and every leaf is hung to make certain of it.
